summary_en: The video provides a detailed cooking tutorial on making lemongrass and lime pork ribs in a modern kitchen studio. Two female chefs prepare ingredients such as slicing lemons and lemongrass, seasoning the pork ribs, and then proceeding to braise the ribs and deep-fry shredded lemongrass. Finally, the finished dish is beautifully plated, followed by a recipe overview screen.
